notes_for_editor: The three pages agree on the 1928 camp, the 1930 10-foot L-4 tower, the Cameron Hill patrol point, the 5,591-foot elevation and the 1964 destruction. Weebly's dates are attributed to Kresek and firelookout.com's to the same record, so these may not be independent. The name story, the 1936 Halm quote and the 1953 Boy Scout item come only from the Forest Lookouts page, which reprints 1936 and 1953 newspaper items; they were not checked against the newspapers. Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history and shows an undated photo from the Bert Russel Collection; the photo has no image URL in our read, so no photo record is added. A web search found no account of what remains on the summit. The brief's 'gone' status is consistent with 'Destroyed 1964'. Do not confuse with us-or-cemetery-ridge, the Oregon site.
